blocks.content: Table 7-24. Address 801h: PHY Near End Loopback Control (Sheet 2 of 2)

|  Bit | Default | Attribute | Required | Description  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  [2:0] | 0h | Level | PCIe, USB, USB4, and SATA | **NELB Loopback Position** Encodings for the original PIPE: Refer to Figure 8-45. 0 - At PIPE interface boundary 1 - At Elastic Buffer Inlet 2 - At PIPE interface side of deserializer/serializer 3 - At die pad side of deserializer/serializer 4 - High Speed Digital / Analog Path 1 5 - PHY Specific Path 1 6 - PHY Specific Path 2 7 - PHY Specific Path 3 Encodings for SerDes architecture: Refer to Figure 8-46. 0 - At PIPE interface boundary 1 - Reserved 2 - Reserved 3 - At die edge side of de-serializer/serializer 4 - High Speed Digital / Analog Path 1 5 - PHY Specific Path 1 6 - PHY Specific Path 2 7 - PHY Specific Path 3 At least one of the positions 0, 1, or 2 must be support by PHYs that support the NELB feature. It is strongly recommended to support position 1 or 2 in Original PIPE architecture mode.  |
